Title: Project Wiki Test Fixture Overview
Content: The project wiki includes purpose-built test fixture memories with the test-fixture tag so integration tests can exercise search, context packs, references, conflicts, backlinks, maxRecords, and format=json without depending only on incidental product documentation. The fixture graph uses stable ids and unique query markers such as quartzwave and nimbusvector. Tests should copy Data/Memories to a temp directory before mutating records, then use these fixture ids for deterministic graph assertions.
